_comment: Regenerates demo/assets/claimscene-07-architecture.png. Patches the two stale stat numbers AND the GenblazeMediaProvider line, which described a pipeline stage that no longer runs (issue #32). Numbers come from the latest green CI run on main (README.md:393 backend, README.md:402 frontend); the adapter line comes from src/claimscene/pipeline.py, where still_model is None and still_source is 'schematic:impact_frame'. Run via: python scripts/patch_gallery_card.py demo/assets/src/claimscene-07-architecture.patch.json -- or push a change to this file and let .github/workflows/render-cards.yml do it.

patches.note: GenblazeMediaProvider line 1: 'seedream-5.0-lite still' claimed a model call that no longer happens. The still is a raster of the deterministic schematic (pipeline.py: still_model=None, still_source='schematic:impact_frame'). Line 2 ('pixverse-v6-i2v clip - GMI') is still accurate and is deliberately left alone. Geometry measured from the shipped PNG's own pixels: ink spans x 331..479, y 391..398 (25 chars at 5.94 px/char), grey (138,153,160) on the box fill (14,22,25) -- hence the palette override. Three neighbours constrain the erase and are why pad drops to 2: the box title's glyph bottoms end at y=387, line 2 starts at y=406, and the box's right border is a single column at x=716.
